Class SocketServerHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.network.socket.client.SocketServerHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServerSocket, VirtualServer
public class SocketServerHandler extends Object implements VirtualServerSocket
This class handles the communication between the client and the server
